name: The Ritz Carlton Haikou
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton, Haikou: a golf resort on Hainan Island, in the volcanic region of Haikou city, next to the Blackstone Golf Course
best_for: Golfers who want to stay beside the Blackstone Golf Course
Families with children aged 3 to 10 who can use the Kids Club

facts.text: The hotel is in the volcanic region of Haikou city on Hainan Island, China.
It is the first golf resort of The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company in China, adjacent to the 350-acre Blackstone Golf Course.
Mission Hills Resort, Haikou has 10 volcanic golf courses.
Dining includes Afternoon Tea at the Ritz-Carlton Bar & Lounge, all-day dining at Terra, Cantonese cuisine at Tin Lung Heen and the rooftop bar Flair.
Tin Lung Heen, the Cantonese restaurant, has five private outdoor dining rooms.
The spa has a steam room, cool mist showers and indoor vitality pools.
The Kids Club has a separate children's pool, playground games and toys for children aged 3 to 10.
The TimeSDF Haikou Mission Hills Duty Free Shop is a 3-minute walk from the hotel.

highlights.text: The hotel is built on ancient lava bedrock from extinct volcanoes, with rocky outcrops, jungle vegetation, lakes and wetlands that can be viewed from every room.
Flair is a rooftop lounge with views of the sunset and the golf course.
The spa offers a golf-inspired treatment and a ritual that combines coconut and Agar wood, local to Hainan.
The Club Lounge is on the 19th floor and has a classic European home-style design.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service, and Haikou Meilan International Airport is 16.0 km from the hotel.
The hotel's dress code asks guests to be smart casual at all times.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
